Reworking Sunset Moment, the first popular design in the Weaving+ series, this case weaves an immersive blue time from sunset to moonrise. The Weaving+ Moment series captures these fleeting moments in aramid fiber through countless experiments and explorations.
Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, the case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture. It is light and strong, and a pleasure to hold every single time.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel, ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
